Abstract

We propose the Transformer, a model architecture based entirely on attention mechanisms.

Method

Our encoder and decoder use multi-head self-attention and positional encoding.

Training

Optimizer: Adam. We train with learning rate 2e-5, batch size 32, and 3 epochs.

Dataset

We use the WikiText dataset.

Loss

We optimize cross entropy loss.

References

  1. Vaswani et al. Attention Is All You Need.
